descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Draft sports trading card features Dawel Lugo, a player from the Detroit Tigers team. The card is a Chrome Refractor variation, with a card number of BDC-176. It was manufactured by Topps in the year 2017 and belongs to the MLB league.

The card is standard-sized and is not autographed. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection. Get this card from the Sports Trading Card category of the Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop.
